composition.basis: marker-adjusted own interfaces; runtime waiting excluded; wrapper calibration is an estimate
composition.contract: Observed calls only. F includes U. U includes descendant unexplained work. N*F denotes N applications of an atomic child interface, not N times a global measured mean. Argument mappings are metadata, not prerequisites for child multipliers. Own cost fits and U tables are per-state means across callers. No prediction of per-invocation inclusive counts or latency.

exampleValidation.scope: Observed single-thread reconstruction including tabulated U; not held-out cost prediction
